tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch5:5.17

Musical isomorphisms commute with total covariant differentiation. If $F$ has a contravariant $i$th index and $ lat $ lowers that index, then egin{equation} abla (F^ lat )=( abla F)^ lat . ag {5.14} \end{equation} If $G$ has a covariant $i$th index and $\sharp $ raises it, then egin{equation} abla (G^\sharp )=( abla G)^\sharp . ag {5.15} \end{equation}

Proof

\sketch Lowering the $i$th index is the corresponding contraction in $F\otimes g$. Since $ abla g=0$ and covariant differentiation commutes with contraction,

\[ abla _X(F^ lat ) = abla _X\operatorname {tr}(F\otimes g) =\operatorname {tr}(( abla _XF)\otimes g) =( abla _XF)^ lat . \]

This proves (5.14). Apply it to $F=G^\sharp $ and then raise the same index to obtain (5.15).

□
